name: codex-profile-read-aliases
goal: Reject hard-linked aliases within native Codex read grants before provider launch.

evidence: A native sandbox allowed reading a synthetic hard link under a granted runtime directory while denying the original secret path; the profile must reject unsafe aliases before launch.
The existing prepare method case checks assigned-file and scratch aliases but not aliases inside admitted runtime or sealed CLI directories, nor a linked snapshot. Strengthen that same case.
